import collections
import text

rows := [
    "#############",
    "#S..#.......#",
    "#.#.#.###.#.#",
    "#.#...#...#.#",
    "#.###.#.###.#",
    "#...#...#...#",
    "###.#####.#.#",
    "#.......#..G#",
    "#############",
]
maze := rows.join("").characters()
start := maze.index("S")
goal := maze.index("G")
parent := array(#maze, fill = -1)
parent[start] = int(start)
queue := collections.Queue<int>([int(start)])
directions := [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
while not queue.empty() and parent[goal] == -1
    current := .queue.take()
    r := current / 13
    c := current % 13
    for (dr, dc) := directions[]
        nr := r + dr
        nc := c + dc
        if 0 <= nr < 9 and 0 <= nc < 13
            neighbor := nr * 13 + nc
            if maze[neighbor] != "#" and parent[neighbor] == -1
                parent[neighbor] = current
                .queue.push(neighbor)
steps := 0
current := int(goal)
while current != int(start)
    if maze[current] == "."
        maze[current] = "*"
    current = parent[current]
    steps += 1
println("steps: {steps}")
marked_rows := maze.chunks(13)
for row := marked_rows[]
    println(row.join(""))
